label: LoRA Lab: Sci-Fi Style
description: Style-mover LoRAs that push a whole frame into cyberpunk or hard science fiction. Trigger phrases are woven into the item text verbatim; data carries the exact filename, creator-stated strength and Civitai AIR urn. Tagged by base-model family — these are the movers a style A/B should compare within one family, never across.

items.name: cyberpunk-anime-flux
items.text: anime, cyberpunk, hard neon graphics laid over clean animated cel shapes, rain-lit signage doing the colour work

lora_info.name: Cyberpunk Anime Style (Flux)
lora_info.creator: CN_Signal
lora_info.about: Fuses cel-animation shape language with neon cyberpunk lighting in one pass; the dominant cyberpunk-anime style LoRA at 42,989 model downloads and 4,308 thumbs-up, 24,532 on the Flux version alone.

items.name: cyberpunk-sdxl
items.text: cyberpunk style, saturated signage light bleeding across wet chrome and glass, hard magenta and cyan doing the modelling

lora_info.name: [Lah] Cyberpunk | SDXL
lora_info.creator: Lah_Inthe_Futureland
lora_info.about: A clean, fully SFW cyberpunk look for SDXL recommended at 0.4-1.0 weight; 7,778 downloads and 618 thumbs-up with an entirely work-safe example gallery.

items.name: scifi-environments-flux
items.text: coherent science-fiction set design, plausible hardware and lived-in industrial surfaces holding together across the whole frame

lora_info.name: Sci-fi Environments (Flux v1.0)
lora_info.creator: CN_Signal
lora_info.about: Builds internally consistent sci-fi environments — greebles, panel logic and wear that agree with each other; the top result for sci-fi LoRA searches at 21,334 model downloads and 1,847 thumbs-up.
